name: Jumping snail
summary: The snail Sông Cầu also calls ốc đực. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note says the meat is the color of chicken fat, crisp, sweet, and fatty, and that the plate to order is steamed with lemongrass and mắm gừng. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Sông Cầu, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names ốc nhảy on the provincial plate and does not print a method.
texture: The 29 December 2020 note says the meat is the color of chicken fat, crisp, sweet, and fatty.
howToEat: Steamed with lemongrass, eaten with mắm gừng. That is the plate the 29 December 2020 note calls the best. A price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The Sông Cầu sea. The same note also lists ốc giấm, ốc nón, ốc gai, ốc mỡ, ốc giác, ốc bàn tay, and ốc đỏ, and singles out ốc nhảy. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Oc nhay in Song Cau — steamed with lemongrass
seoDescription: Jumping snail from Song Cau, also called oc duc, steamed with lemongrass and mam gung. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
